title: ci-local.sh gate 2 was extended to 4 test binaries but .github/workflows/ci.yml was not touched — the r1-B6 test gate exists only locally, violating the script's own mirror rule
evidence:
tools/ci-local.sh:10-11: "# The gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow
# is the spec; never edit one without the other. Same order, same failure". tools/ci-local.sh:56 (new in this diff): "  \"Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && odin test app -out:bin/app-test && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test\"". .github/workflows/ci.yml:69-70 (unchanged): "      - name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)
        run: odin test core". git diff v2...217f6a8 -- .github/ → empty (the PR never edits the workflow).
detail: The B6 fix's test binaries (app settings_test, render hud_test, harness a11y_oracle_test) never run on GitHub Actions; the gate label and the 'do NOT add setup steps' comment (line 53) are also now stale.
recommended_fix: Mirror gate 2 into ci.yml (mkdir -p bin + the four odin test invocations), or document the deliberate local-only split in both files.

title: still present since round 1: the 25 parity scenarios never run under any a11y mode — ui_scale/reduced_motion appear nowhere in parity.odin
evidence:
harness/parity.odin:176-184 (drive_parity): "	view: rnd.View
	view.catalogs = cat // the render package reads the catalogs (tray chip count/rects)
	...
	pal := rnd.palette_load()
	view.palette = &pal
	rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)"; grep 'ui_scale|reduced_motion' harness/parity.odin → 0 matches (verified). Same defaults in run_input_parity (parity.odin:934).
detail: Story AC 'full input parity holds under every a11y mode' is still construction-argued only; ui_scale moves hit rects (settings chip width), so the under-scale leg remains unexercised.
recommended_fix: Drive the parity matrix once at ×1.50 (a scenario field that sets view.ui_scale in drive_parity) — the a11y demos prove sim-hash identity, not input parity.

title: still present since round 1: the spec's '1152×648 min-window' scale AC is claimed 'AC-pinned' but no code path renders at that size
evidence: spec line 47: "| Scale ×1.50 at min window 1152×648 | panel stepper | top band (health card, forecast, crisis banner), QoS panel, tray, caption strip never overlap | layout clamps, AC-pinned |". harness/goldens.odin:80: "	rnd.view_compute(&rc.view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)". app/render/hud_test.odin:71: "	v.win_w = 1280". grep '1152|648' harness/ tools/*.sh → 0 matches.
detail: Every harness and test path renders at 1280-wide; r2's hud_test pins the banner clamp at win_w=1280 only, so the min-window AC line over-claims.
recommended_fix: Add a 1152×648 leg (a hud_test win_w case or a harness window override), or soften the spec's 'AC-pinned' to the exercised 1280 width.

title: still present since round 1: no presence/content scans for the a11y_reduced and a11y_scale goldens; the a11y demo-verb parse-error legs are untested
evidence: harness/palcheck.odin:414 (run_palcheck section 4, the only golden-scan loop): "		modes := []rnd.Palette_Mode{.Deutan, .Protan, .Tritan}" — the loop below scans only goldens/a11y_{deutan,protan,tritan}/ frames; no code references goldens/a11y_reduced or goldens/a11y_scale outside the T2 hash compare.
detail: reduced/scale demos rely on the T2 hash alone; the new parser's error paths (bad mode name, bad pct) have no negative tests.
recommended_fix: Extend palcheck section 4 (e.g. reduced crisis frame keeps full-width outline; scale frame HUD measurably larger) or add demo-parse error-leg tests.

title: still present since round 1: palcheck picks the 40-vs-48 separation threshold by pr[0] color-value equality, not pair identity
detail: A future mode edit that sets a signal token's VALUE equal to a map token's silently moves that pair under the looser 40 threshold.
recommended_fix: Build the pairs with an explicit is-map flag (token indices) and key the threshold on that, not on color equality.

title: still present since round 1: orphaned '// 16. pause' comment sits above the settings-panel scenario in parity.odin
detail: The numbered comment describes the wrong scenario; the pause scenario lost its header. Pure comment hygiene in the scenario catalog.
recommended_fix: Renumber: give the settings scenario its own numbered comment and restore '16' to the pause scenario.

title: still present since round 1: _pr_body.md is committed and tracked at the repo root
evidence:
git ls-files _pr_body.md → _pr_body.md (tracked). The diff adds it as a root-level file: "diff --git a/_pr_body.md b/_pr_body.md
new file mode 100644" — 82 lines including the round-specific 'r1 → r2 rework' section.
detail: PR-body scratch shipped in the tree; it now embeds per-round review text that will go stale in-repo.

title: still present since round 1: derive_a11y_palettes.py defines scale_lum and mix but never calls them
evidence: tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py:71: "def scale_lum(rgb, target_l):" and :86: "def mix(a, b, t):  # linear mix in 8-bit space" — grep 'scale_lum(' / 'mix(' over the file matches only the two def lines (zero call sites); lum() is called only from inside scale_lum (lines 74/80/83).
detail: Leftover search machinery from an abandoned numeric-search approach; dead paths misrepresent the derivation as numeric when it is hand-anchored.
recommended_fix: Delete scale_lum, mix (and lum, which only scale_lum uses).

title: still present since round 1: spec-7-3 names intents that do not exist, documents a comma demo verb the parser does not implement, and pins reduced-motion at 0.99
evidence: spec line 65: "- `app/input/types.odin` + `poll/controller/touch` -- new Intents (Settings_Toggle, Panel_Navigate, Panel_Activate, Scale_Step); mapped on all devices" vs shipped app/input/types.odin:171/175/181: "Toggle_Settings :: struct {}" / "Settings_Navigate :: struct { delta: i32 }" / "Settings_Activate :: struct { delta: i32 }" (no Scale_Step exists). spec line 67: "- `harness/demo.odin` -- `a11y <mode>[,<mode>]` demo verb" vs demo.odin's shipped subcommands ("a11y palette <name> | a11y reduced | a11y scale <pct>"). spec line 106: "- Reduced-motion static value: a fixed mid-envelope factor (e.g. 0.99)" vs the shipped full-static pin (PR body: 'pins the pulse to full static width').
detail: The committed spec contradicts the shipped intent names, demo-verb syntax, and reduced-motion value; future implementers reading the spec will look for the wrong symbols.
recommended_fix: True up spec lines 65/67/106 to Toggle_Settings/Settings_Navigate/Settings_Activate, the subcommand verb syntax, and the full-static (1.0) pin.
